prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case. A good starting point in Dallas is **Dr. Laura N. Rabe at Dallas Periodontics and Dental Implants**: her practice lists her as board-certified in periodontology and dental implant surgery. **Dr. John Wilson at North Dallas Dental Health** is another option; his practice also lists him as a board-certified periodontist and implant specialist.

Before choosing, get a consultation and ask who will place the implant and who will make the crown, what imaging and bone-grafting might be needed, the full cost and timeline, and how complications are handled. Consider a second opinion—especially if the case involves bone loss, gum disease, or multiple implants—and verify credentials and insurance coverage directly with the office.
